title: FixtureSeatsApiSdk Tool Definitions
description: LLM tool calling bindings for fixture-seats-api API

tools.name: problem.seats.leaveSeat
tools.title: Problem seats: leave seat

mcp.name: Problem seats: leave seat
mcp.description: Unseats a subject from a seat: the caller, which needs no permission, or another, with the seat's assign permission. The subject the seat's fromField holds cannot leave while it holds them. A subject not seated is answered unchanged.

tools.description: Unseats a subject from a seat: the caller, which needs no permission, or another, with the seat's assign permission. The subject the seat's fromField holds cannot leave while it holds them. A subject not seated is answered unchanged.

id.description: The key of the Problem row the operation runs on.

subject.description: The subject to unseat; the caller's own when absent. Unseating another needs the seat's assign permission.

tools.name: problem.seats.listSeats
tools.title: Problem seats: list seats

mcp.name: Problem seats: list seats
mcp.description: Lists the subjects seated on the row, by seat in code point order, each seat's fromField subject first and then the others in the order they were seated; with seat, only its subjects.

tools.description: Lists the subjects seated on the row, by seat in code point order, each seat's fromField subject first and then the others in the order they were seated; with seat, only its subjects.

id.description: The key of the Problem row the operation runs on.

tools.name: problem.seats.takeSeat
tools.title: Problem seats: take seat

mcp.name: Problem seats: take seat
mcp.description: Seats a subject in a seat: the caller, with the seat's take permission when it names one, or another, with its assign permission. A full seat refuses it, or unseats the subject seated longest when its onFull is displace. A subject seated already is answered unchanged.

tools.description: Seats a subject in a seat: the caller, with the seat's take permission when it names one, or another, with its assign permission. A full seat refuses it, or unseats the subject seated longest when its onFull is displace. A subject seated already is answered unchanged.

id.description: The key of the Problem row the operation runs on.

subject.description: The subject to seat; the caller's own when absent. Seating another needs the seat's assign permission.

tools.name: problem.status.transition
tools.title: Problem status: transition

mcp.name: Problem status: transition
mcp.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

tools.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

from.description: The state the caller read the instance in. An instance in another state refuses the move as the veto stale, before anything else is checked, so a retry that finds its move made is stale with the state it moved to. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

id.description: The key of the Problem row the operation runs on.

tools.name: sandbox.observed.observe
tools.title: Sandbox observed: observe

mcp.name: Sandbox observed: observe
mcp.description: Records the state the provider reports, when at is newer than the last observation's, and moves the Workflow there along the fewest transitions its config allows, each as the caller, so every guard and permission holds each step; a step refused stops there and records drift. An observation no newer is answered unchanged. Needs observePermission.

tools.description: Records the state the provider reports, when at is newer than the last observation's, and moves the Workflow there along the fewest transitions its config allows, each as the caller, so every guard and permission holds each step; a step refused stops there and records drift. at.description: When the provider was observed in it, in epoch milliseconds, no later than the call.

id.description: The key of the Sandbox row the operation runs on.

state.description: The state the provider reports, a state of the Workflow status names.
